checks: Independent active uncovered inventory equals rendered eligibility; each surface mask follows received status; all internal modules excluded.
Three segments AVAILABLE→SALE_OPEN→SOLD→AVAILABLE→BLOCKED→SOLD update mask/frame/check without geometry rebuild.
Hover/selection preserve commercial identity; selected filtered lot strength remains 1; infrastructure clears mask and hides accessories, then restores.
Hidden lot layer hides surface/status, frame and confirmation together.
Five warmed status cycles retain geometry, texture and program allocations.
Public three-state normalization: open/confirmed share permitted blue and never reveal a confirmation check.

performance.method: One scene at a time. Complete hydration + 2s idle, two unmeasured 4s gestures separated by 4s idle, then 3 repeated 5s rotations. Native pointer down/up; elapsed-time pointer trajectory. Frame durations from the existing bounded diagnostics: last 240 active navigation/damping samples per repetition; idle frames excluded. Fixed quality and DPR; no quality compensation. Public fixture mounts independently with existing scene policy; no live token. Boot reports the existing first-interactive readiness marker (controls installed and presented frames), not end-to-end user task completion.
performance.environment: macOS 26.6, Apple M5, ANGLE Metal, headless Chrome, 1366x768 DPR1
